business_summary: REFINVERSE Group, Inc. operates as a material recycling company in Japan. It operates in two segments, Materials Business and Resource Business. The Materials Business segment offers collection and disposal services for used carpet tiles; recycling of used carpet tiles; sale of recycled resin; sale of recycled resin produced from automotive airbag manufacturing scraps and used fishing nets through cutting, washing, thermoplasticizing, and extrusion; and recycled raw materials for manufacturing products. The Resource Business segment engages in intermediate treatment/recycling business of industrial waste; and provides collection and transportation services, as well as demolition work of offices and condominiums. It also offers refine powder, steelmaking materials, REAMIDE, and regenerative polio (leffin). REFINVERSE Group, Inc. was founded in 1983 and is headquartered in Chiyoda, Japan.
